panels.title: Processed events per window · by source

targets.query:
from(bucket: "cryptosentinel")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cryptosentinel_pipeline" and r._field == "processed_events")
  |> group(columns: ["source"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "processed_events")

from(bucket: "cryptosentinel")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cryptosentinel_pipeline" and r._field == "flagged_predictions")
  |> group(columns: ["source"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "flagged")

from(bucket: "cryptosentinel")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cryptosentinel_pipeline" and r._field == "processing_latency_ms")
  |> group(columns: ["source"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean_latency_ms")

from(bucket: "cryptosentinel")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cryptosentinel_pipeline" and (r._field == "invalid_records" or r._field == "processing_errors" or r._field == "dropped_records"))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "quality_counts")

from(bucket: "cryptosentinel")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cryptosentinel_services" and r._field == "up")
  |> group(columns: ["service"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "service_up")
